title: ActionEvent
description: What the customer actually did with a surfaced decision. Captures the gap between recommended and applied -- 'modified' is signal, not noise. Also carries the experiment assignment when a holdout was used, so treated vs. control is knowable.

response.description: accepted = applied as recommended; modified = applied differently (capture what in applied_change); rejected/no_action = not applied. All four are training signal.

applied_change.description: What was actually applied (may differ from the recommendation when response='modified').

experiment.description: Present only when this decision was rolled out with a holdout. Enables the experimental attribution method.

arm.description: Which arm the acting unit was assigned to.
